title: Motor Imagery dataset from Cho et al 2017
description: A motor imagery brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 52 healthy subjects performing kinesthetic imagery of left and right hand finger movements. The dataset includes 100-120 trials per class with concurrent EMG recordings, psychological and physiological questionnaires, 3D electrode coordinates, and non-task-related control states. Mean classification accuracy of 67.46% (±13.17%) demonstrates substantial inter-subject variability in motor imagery performance.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 512 Hz using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 64 active electrodes in standard 1005 montage plus 4 EMG channels. Subjects performed kinesthetic motor imagery of left and right hand finger movements during 3-second cued trials. Each session consisted of 5-6 runs with 100-120 trials per class. Additional data included non-task-related states (eye blinking, eyeball movements, head movement, jaw clenching, resting state) and real hand movement trials. 3D electrode coordinates were measured using Polhemus Fastrak digitizer.
